Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J37/J37nB389.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yuzhaoyunfen of Hongshan. Xiaotang Yunfen owns the retained answer: granted the great man's realm — truly different! — after his left foot, he answers by hanging down his right foot.

Senses.Explanation: The great man's realm of the Chan records: the sphere beyond reckoning — announced with a warning, catalogued with the first truth's names, granted to the two recluses, and answered with a hanging foot. Shengke Deyu announces the great man's realm to you — take it on just now, is that it? — and warns that gold dust in the eye becomes a film, so better no such good thing, Yuejiang Zhengyin catalogues it among the first truth's names — the king-of-summit concentration, the floating-banner king's ocean of realm-lands, the Manjusri-and-Samantabhadra great man's realm — then holds up one flower for the assembly and gets the golden kinsman's breaking smile, Muyun Tongmen grants it to Hanshan and Shide: the great man's realm is only for you to know and me to know — beggar's tricks, used to scaring ghosts with gods — and had Fenggan not gossiped, who to this day would know those two thieves, and Yingshan Zhiyin hands the layman the ox-and-horse verse of Dushun as the upward man's walking, the Manjusri-and-Samantabhadra great man's realm, asking whether his correspondent can accord with it — and if he can, moving by day like a dragon finding water, a tiger pacing the mountain, every step the play-sphere. Eryin Mi grades Yunmen as the elephant crossing the river, cutting through with every step traceless, against the head-seat as the fox on the ice, trembling forward and back and never done — then asks what the Manjusri-and-Samantabhadra great man's realm is: the sixteen-year beauty too lazy to comb her hair, letting her tangle hang — bone-fine to the end, wanton without powder — Zhufeng Huanmin rules the great man's realm interpenetrates, so the late-age temple should be planned, the mountain staff needing no ornament but the gate of the building-conversion wanting its arrangements, Cuiya Bi opens his installation by turning the formula both ways — the ancient buddhas' house style returns to the great man's realm, the great man's realm manifests the ancient buddhas' house style, the teaching following the teaching's own walking — and Xiaotang Yunfen, granted the great man's realm by his questioner's cry of truly different, answers by hanging down his right foot.
